title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 16 | The Sunlit Castle | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
Mischievous bats steal the sun crystal from the Sunlit Castle! Lumi the Paladin joins the party, protects everyone with a Divine Shield in the castle belfry, and a Holy Light brings the crystal home, just in time for the sunlight festival with fireworks and cupcakes.

0:00 The Castle Gates
0:45 Lumi the Paladin
1:30 Battle in the Belfry
2:15 The Sunlight Festival

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
